name: CARITAS — The Healing Place (Men's & Women's Campuses)
description: CARITAS operates The Healing Place, a long-term, peer-driven residential recovery program offered free of charge to men and women with substance use disorders in the greater Richmond area. The men's campus on Dinwiddie Avenue has 196 beds and the women's campus at the CARITAS Center has 142 beds. Participants live on campus while working a structured recovery curriculum with peer mentors, then transition through workforce development toward independent housing.
description_es: CARITAS opera The Healing Place, un programa residencial de recuperación a largo plazo, dirigido por pares y gratuito para hombres y mujeres con trastornos por uso de sustancias en el área metropolitana de Richmond. El campus de hombres en Dinwiddie Avenue tiene 196 camas y el de mujeres en el CARITAS Center tiene 142 camas. Los participantes viven en el campus siguiendo un currículo estructurado de recuperación y luego pasan a desarrollo laboral hacia una vivienda independiente.
eligibility: Adult men and women with substance use disorders; on-demand admission at no cost; people leaving incarceration are accepted.
eligibility_es: Hombres y mujeres adultos con trastornos por uso de sustancias; admisión según disponibilidad sin costo; se aceptan personas que salen de la encarcelación.
notes: Men's intake 804-230-1184 (700 Dinwiddie Avenue); women's intake 804-418-3049 (2220 Stockton Street); for emergency shelter call the Homeless Connection Line at 804-972-0813.
notes_es: Admisión de hombres 804-230-1184 (700 Dinwiddie Avenue); admisión de mujeres 804-418-3049 (2220 Stockton Street); para refugio de emergencia llame a la Homeless Connection Line al 804-972-0813.
hours: Residential program 24/7; intake lines during business hours
services: Long-term residential recovery|Peer-driven recovery curriculum|Emergency shelter referral|Workforce development|Recovery residence transition

name: CARITAS Recovery Residences
description: CARITAS Recovery Residences offers safe, affordable sober-living apartments at the CARITAS Center in South Richmond for men and women at any point in their recovery journey. Residents live in a structured, substance-free community with access to CARITAS recovery programming, the CARITAS Works six-week workforce development program, and the Furniture Bank for household goods when they move into permanent housing.
description_es: CARITAS Recovery Residences ofrece apartamentos de vida sobria seguros y asequibles en el CARITAS Center, al sur de Richmond, para hombres y mujeres en cualquier punto de su recuperación. Los residentes viven en una comunidad estructurada y libre de sustancias con acceso a la programación de recuperación de CARITAS, al programa de desarrollo laboral CARITAS Works de seis semanas y al banco de muebles al mudarse a una vivienda permanente.
eligibility: Men and women in recovery from substance use disorders at any stage; rent is affordable and income-based; criminal records are not an automatic bar.
eligibility_es: Hombres y mujeres en recuperación de trastornos por uso de sustancias en cualquier etapa; la renta es asequible y basada en ingresos; los antecedentes penales no son una barrera automática.
notes: Contact RecoveryResidences@caritasva.org or 804-801-5082 to apply; the CARITAS Works employment program can be reached at 804-612-1752; Furniture Bank 804-358-0964 ext. 302.
notes_es: Contacte RecoveryResidences@caritasva.org o el 804-801-5082 para solicitar; el programa de empleo CARITAS Works está en el 804-612-1752; banco de muebles 804-358-0964 ext. 302.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Sober-living apartments|Recovery programming|Workforce development|Furniture Bank access|Case management

name: REAL LIFE — Recovery & Reentry Housing
description: REAL LIFE operates recovery houses in Richmond with about 130 beds for men and women impacted by incarceration, substance use, or homelessness, serving a primarily reentry population from across Virginia. Residents receive intensive case management from a Pathway Navigator, a behavior-modification curriculum, employment navigation with more than 100 employer partners, and required recovery classes as they work toward graduation and independent living.
description_es: REAL LIFE opera casas de recuperación en Richmond con unas 130 camas para hombres y mujeres afectados por la encarcelación, el uso de sustancias o la falta de vivienda, sirviendo principalmente a una población en reinserción de toda Virginia. Los residentes reciben manejo de caso intensivo de un Pathway Navigator, un currículo de modificación de conducta, orientación de empleo con más de 100 empleadores aliados y clases de recuperación requeridas mientras avanzan hacia la vida independiente.
eligibility: Adults impacted by incarceration, substance use, or homelessness; apply online or through a prison reentry counselor; people can apply from custody as part of a home plan.
eligibility_es: Adultos afectados por la encarcelación, el uso de sustancias o la falta de vivienda; solicite en línea o a través de un consejero de reinserción de la prisión; se puede solicitar desde custodia como parte de un plan de hogar.
notes: Submit one application online and expect up to a week for review plus a phone interview; people in prison can request an application through their reentry counselor; email is answered faster than calls.
notes_es: Envíe una sola solicitud en línea y espere hasta una semana para revisión más una entrevista telefónica; las personas en prisión pueden pedir la solicitud a su consejero de reinserción; el correo electrónico se responde más rápido que las llamadas.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours; houses 24/7
services: Recovery housing|Intensive case management|Employment navigation|Behavior-modification curriculum|Reentry support

name: HomeAgain — Emergency Shelters & Rapid Rehousing
description: HomeAgain has served greater Richmond since 1979 with year-round emergency shelters, bridge housing, rapid rehousing, and permanent supportive housing. Its City Family Shelter downtown houses up to 50 women, mothers, and families with case management, housing and job search help, and mental health support, while community housing programs place individuals and families in scattered-site apartments with short- and long-term rental subsidies.
description_es: HomeAgain sirve al área metropolitana de Richmond desde 1979 con refugios de emergencia todo el año, vivienda puente, realojamiento rápido y vivienda de apoyo permanente. Su City Family Shelter en el centro aloja hasta 50 mujeres, madres y familias con manejo de caso, ayuda de búsqueda de vivienda y empleo y apoyo de salud mental, mientras los programas comunitarios ubican a personas y familias en apartamentos dispersos con subsidios de renta.
eligibility: Individuals and families experiencing homelessness in the greater Richmond region; all placements come through the Homeless Connection Line coordinated entry, not direct referral.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias sin hogar en la región metropolitana de Richmond; todas las colocaciones pasan por la entrada coordinada de la Homeless Connection Line, no por referencia directa.
notes: Call the Homeless Connection Line at 804-972-0813 to be assessed for shelter (Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–9 p.m., Sat–Sun 1–9 p.m.); the Maywill Street office is administrative and for donations only.
notes_es: Llame a la Homeless Connection Line al 804-972-0813 para una evaluación de refugio (lun–vie 8 a.m.–9 p.m., sáb–dom 1–9 p.m.); la oficina de Maywill Street es administrativa y solo para donaciones.
hours: Shelters 24/7; office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Emergency shelter|Rapid rehousing|Permanent supportive housing|Case management|Housing search assistance

name: SupportWorks Housing (formerly Virginia Supportive Housing)
description: SupportWorks Housing is Virginia's largest and oldest provider of permanent supportive housing, combining affordable apartments with individualized support services to end homelessness across greater Richmond, South Hampton Roads, and Charlottesville. Programs include supportive apartment communities like Cool Lane Commons, the HomeLink scattered-site program for chronically homeless single adults with disabilities, and Supportive Services for Veteran Families.
description_es: SupportWorks Housing es el proveedor más grande y antiguo de vivienda de apoyo permanente de Virginia, combinando apartamentos asequibles con servicios de apoyo individualizados para acabar con la falta de vivienda en Richmond, South Hampton Roads y Charlottesville. Sus programas incluyen comunidades de apartamentos como Cool Lane Commons, el programa HomeLink de sitios dispersos para adultos solteros con discapacidades y servicios de apoyo para familias de veteranos.
eligibility: Adults experiencing homelessness, including chronically homeless single adults, veterans, older adults, and persons with disabilities; income limits apply; referrals flow through regional coordinated entry.
eligibility_es: Adultos sin hogar, incluidos adultos con falta de vivienda crónica, veteranos, adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades; aplican límites de ingresos; las referencias pasan por la entrada coordinada regional.
notes: Call 804-788-6825 for program information; veterans seeking SSVF help should ask for the intake coordinator at ext. 260; in Richmond, shelter placement starts with the Homeless Connection Line 804-972-0813.
notes_es: Llame al 804-788-6825 para información de programas; los veteranos que buscan ayuda SSVF deben pedir el coordinador de admisión en la ext. 260; en Richmond, la colocación en refugio comienza con la Homeless Connection Line 804-972-0813.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Permanent supportive housing|Affordable apartments|Case management|Veteran family services|Housing stability support

name: The Salvation Army Richmond — Chamberlayne Avenue Shelters
description: The Salvation Army operates the City of Richmond's year-round 50-bed men's shelter and the seasonal 100-bed Inclement Weather Shelter at 1900 Chamberlayne Avenue. The men's shelter provides beds, meals, and case management year-round, while the Inclement Weather Shelter opens each winter from 5 p.m. to 8 a.m. on a first-come, first-served basis. The Community Resource and Training Center at the same address connects guests to services.
description_es: El Ejército de Salvación opera el refugio de hombres de 50 camas de la ciudad de Richmond, abierto todo el año, y el refugio de clima inclemente de 100 camas, ambos en 1900 Chamberlayne Avenue. El refugio de hombres ofrece camas, comidas y manejo de caso todo el año, mientras el refugio de clima inclemente abre cada invierno de 5 p.m. a 8 a.m. por orden de llegada. El Community Resource and Training Center en la misma dirección conecta a los huéspedes con servicios.
eligibility: Year-round men's shelter serves single adult men referred through the Homeless Connection Line; the seasonal Inclement Weather Shelter is open to adults on a walk-up, first-come basis during winter.
eligibility_es: El refugio de hombres todo el año sirve a hombres adultos solteros referidos por la Homeless Connection Line; el refugio de clima inclemente está abierto a adultos por orden de llegada durante el invierno.
notes: There is no walk-in intake for the year-round shelter—call the Homeless Connection Line at 804-972-0813; the Inclement Weather Shelter operates roughly November 15–April 15, 5 p.m.–8 a.m., entrance via side alley.
notes_es: No hay admisión directa para el refugio anual—llame a la Homeless Connection Line al 804-972-0813; el refugio de clima inclemente opera aproximadamente del 15 de noviembre al 15 de abril, 5 p.m.–8 a.m., entrada por el callejón lateral.
hours: Men's shelter 24/7 via referral; Inclement Weather Shelter seasonal 5:00 p.m.–8:00 a.m.
services: Year-round men's shelter|Seasonal inclement weather shelter|Meals|Case management|Resource center connection

name: ForKids — Housing Crisis Hotline & Housing Programs
description: ForKids operates the Regional Housing Crisis Hotline, the central entry point for anyone facing homelessness or eviction across 14 cities and counties in Southeastern Virginia, answering more than 77,000 calls a year. From its Landmark Center headquarters in Chesapeake, ForKids also provides emergency shelter, rapid rehousing, homelessness prevention, and comprehensive family services including education support and case management.
description_es: ForKids opera la Regional Housing Crisis Hotline, el punto central de entrada para cualquier persona que enfrenta la falta de vivienda o el desalojo en 14 ciudades y condados del sureste de Virginia, respondiendo más de 77,000 llamadas al año. Desde su sede Landmark Center en Chesapeake, ForKids también ofrece refugio de emergencia, realojamiento rápido, prevención de la falta de vivienda y servicios familiares integrales con apoyo educativo y manejo de caso.
eligibility: Anyone experiencing a housing crisis in Greater Hampton Roads—living on the street, in shelter, or facing eviction; hotline staff assess and refer to available programs.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona en crisis de vivienda en Greater Hampton Roads—viviendo en la calle, en refugio o enfrentando desalojo; el personal de la línea evalúa y refiere a los programas disponibles.
notes: Call the Housing Crisis Hotline at 757-587-4202, Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; the hotline does not give direct financial assistance; general office 757-622-6400; browse resources at resources757.org.
notes_es: Llame a la Housing Crisis Hotline al 757-587-4202, lunes–viernes 8 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; la línea no da asistencia financiera directa; oficina general 757-622-6400; consulte recursos en resources757.org.
hours: Hotline Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
services: Housing crisis hotline|Emergency shelter referral|Rapid rehousing|Homelessness prevention|Family case management

name: Union Mission Ministries — Norfolk Shelters
description: Union Mission Ministries runs Norfolk's largest emergency shelter campus, open 24 hours a day with the Bashford Men's Shelter, a women's shelter, cafeteria meals, day services, clothing, case management, and the long-term RECLAIM residential recovery program. The Mission provides more than 72,000 nights of shelter and nearly 190,000 meals each year to men, women, and children across Hampton Roads at no charge.
description_es: Union Mission Ministries dirige el campus de refugio de emergencia más grande de Norfolk, abierto las 24 horas, con el refugio de hombres Bashford, un refugio de mujeres, comidas de cafetería, servicios de día, ropa, manejo de caso y el programa residencial de recuperación RECLAIM. La Misión brinda más de 72,000 noches de refugio y casi 190,000 comidas al año a hombres, mujeres y niños de Hampton Roads sin costo.
eligibility: Men, women, and children experiencing homelessness; faith-based program open to all; call first to confirm bed availability.
eligibility_es: Hombres, mujeres y niños sin hogar; programa basado en la fe abierto a todos; llame primero para confirmar disponibilidad de camas.
notes: Call 757-627-8686 before arriving—men ext. 200, single women ext. 331; the women and children's shelter is temporarily closed but staff offer referrals (ext. 335); men's intake arrival recommended 5–5:15 p.m.; day services 9:30 a.m.–3 p.m. weekdays.
notes_es: Llame al 757-627-8686 antes de llegar—hombres ext. 200, mujeres solteras ext. 331; el refugio de mujeres con niños está cerrado temporalmente pero el personal ofrece referencias (ext. 335); llegada recomendada para hombres 5–5:15 p.m.; servicios de día 9:30 a.m.–3 p.m. entre semana.
hours: Open 24/7; day services Monday–Friday 9:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
services: Emergency shelter|Daily meals|Day services|Residential recovery program|Case management

name: Samaritan House — Emergency & Permanent Housing
description: Samaritan House owns and operates 13 emergency shelter homes at undisclosed locations across Virginia Beach and provides permanent housing through rapid rehousing for homeless families and survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking. Case managers work with each participant on safety planning, financial literacy, vocational help, counseling, and children's services on the path to self-sufficiency and permanent housing.
description_es: Samaritan House posee y opera 13 hogares de refugio de emergencia en ubicaciones no divulgadas en Virginia Beach y ofrece vivienda permanente mediante realojamiento rápido para familias sin hogar y sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual y trata de personas. Los manejadores de caso trabajan con cada participante en planes de seguridad, educación financiera, ayuda vocacional, consejería y servicios para niños hacia la autosuficiencia y la vivienda permanente.
eligibility: Victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking, and families experiencing homelessness; services are free; shelter placement is assessed through hotlines.
eligibility_es: Víctimas de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual y trata de personas, y familias sin hogar; los servicios son gratuitos; la colocación en refugio se evalúa por líneas telefónicas.
notes: For safety-related shelter call the 24-hour crisis hotline 757-430-2120; for general homelessness call the Regional Housing Crisis Hotline 757-587-4202; dial 911 if in immediate danger.
notes_es: Para refugio por seguridad llame a la línea de crisis 24 horas 757-430-2120; para falta de vivienda general llame a la Regional Housing Crisis Hotline 757-587-4202; marque 911 si está en peligro inmediato.
hours: Crisis hotline 24/7; administrative office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Emergency safe housing|Rapid rehousing|Case management|Victim advocacy|Children's services

name: Carpenter's Shelter — Alexandria
description: Carpenter's Shelter serves people experiencing homelessness in the City of Alexandria through the 64-bed Hoffman Center family shelter on North Henry Street and the 64-bed Alexandria Community Shelter on Mill Road, which houses both single adults and families. Beyond beds and daily meals, the shelter provides case management, employment help, and aftercare so clients can address the barriers that led to homelessness and return to permanent housing.
description_es: Carpenter's Shelter sirve a personas sin hogar en la ciudad de Alexandria a través del refugio familiar Hoffman Center de 64 camas en North Henry Street y el Alexandria Community Shelter de 64 camas en Mill Road, que aloja a adultos solteros y familias. Además de camas y comidas diarias, el refugio ofrece manejo de caso, ayuda de empleo y seguimiento para que los clientes superen las barreras que causaron su falta de vivienda y vuelvan a una vivienda permanente.
eligibility: Individuals and families experiencing homelessness in the City of Alexandria; the Hoffman Center is family-only; single adults are served at the Alexandria Community Shelter.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias sin hogar en la ciudad de Alexandria; el Hoffman Center es solo para familias; los adultos solteros son atendidos en el Alexandria Community Shelter.
notes: For emergency shelter placement call Alexandria's Homeless Services Assessment Center at 703-746-5700; Alexandria Community Shelter direct line 703-746-3660; winter shelter 571-652-9984.
notes_es: Para colocación en refugio de emergencia llame al Homeless Services Assessment Center de Alexandria al 703-746-5700; línea directa del Alexandria Community Shelter 703-746-3660; refugio de invierno 571-652-9984.
hours: Shelters 24/7; administrative office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Emergency shelter|Family shelter|Case management|Employment assistance|Aftercare support

name: Shelter House — Fairfax & Loudoun Emergency Shelters
description: Shelter House operates seven emergency shelters across Fairfax and Loudoun counties, including the 62-bed Katherine K. Hanley Family Shelter in Fairfax, all using a rapid rehousing approach that pairs shelter with housing location support, rental assistance, and intensive case management. The organization serves families and individuals experiencing homelessness or fleeing domestic violence and helps them return to permanent housing quickly.
description_es: Shelter House opera siete refugios de emergencia en los condados de Fairfax y Loudoun, incluido el Katherine K. Hanley Family Shelter de 62 camas en Fairfax, todos con un enfoque de realojamiento rápido que combina refugio con búsqueda de vivienda, asistencia de renta y manejo de caso intensivo. La organización sirve a familias y personas sin hogar o que huyen de violencia doméstica y les ayuda a volver rápidamente a una vivienda permanente.
eligibility: Families and individuals experiencing homelessness or domestic violence in Fairfax County and Loudoun County; placement is through county coordinated entry, not walk-in.
eligibility_es: Familias y personas sin hogar o en situación de violencia doméstica en los condados de Fairfax y Loudoun; la colocación es por entrada coordinada del condado, no por llegada directa.
notes: In Fairfax County call Coordinated Services Planning at 703-222-0880 (Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.) for shelter referral; in a domestic violence emergency call the county's 24-hour hotline 703-360-7273.
notes_es: En el condado de Fairfax llame a Coordinated Services Planning al 703-222-0880 (lun–vie 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.) para referencia de refugio; en una emergencia de violencia doméstica llame a la línea 24 horas del condado 703-360-7273.
hours: Shelters 24/7; referrals weekdays via Coordinated Services Planning
services: Emergency shelter|Rapid rehousing|Housing location support|Rental assistance|Intensive case management

name: Miriam's House — Lynchburg Homeless Response
description: Miriam's House leads the Lynchburg area's homeless response system, operating Coordinated Homeless Intake and Access (CHIA), street outreach, rapid rehousing, and permanent supportive housing for people experiencing homelessness in Lynchburg and the counties of Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford, and Campbell. Its solution-focused programs pair stable, affordable housing with financial assistance and supportive services so households do not return to homelessness.
description_es: Miriam's House lidera el sistema de respuesta a la falta de vivienda del área de Lynchburg, operando la entrada coordinada CHIA, alcance en la calle, realojamiento rápido y vivienda de apoyo permanente para personas sin hogar en Lynchburg y los condados de Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford y Campbell. Sus programas combinan vivienda estable y asequible con asistencia financiera y servicios de apoyo para que los hogares no vuelvan a quedar sin vivienda.
eligibility: People who are homeless or within three days of losing housing in Lynchburg, Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford, or Campbell; entry is through the CHIA coordinated intake line.
eligibility_es: Personas sin hogar o a tres días de perder su vivienda en Lynchburg, Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford o Campbell; la entrada es por la línea de admisión coordinada CHIA.
notes: Call the CHIA homeless information line at 434-427-2442 if you are in a housing crisis; office hours Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
notes_es: Llame a la línea de información CHIA al 434-427-2442 si está en crisis de vivienda; horario de oficina lunes–viernes 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
hours: Office Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
services: Coordinated homeless intake|Rapid rehousing|Permanent supportive housing|Street outreach|Financial assistance

name: The Haven — Day Shelter & Housing Programs
description: The Haven is a multi-resource day shelter and housing resource center in downtown Charlottesville, open every morning 365 days a year with breakfast, showers, laundry, mail service, storage, and emergency clothing assistance. Its Housing First programs—homeless prevention, the Haven Housing Fund, and rapid rehousing—connect guests from Charlottesville and surrounding counties to case management and rent assistance that return them to stable housing.
description_es: The Haven es un refugio de día y centro de recursos de vivienda en el centro de Charlottesville, abierto cada mañana los 365 días del año con desayuno, duchas, lavandería, servicio de correo, almacenamiento y ayuda de ropa de emergencia. Sus programas Housing First—prevención, el Haven Housing Fund y realojamiento rápido—conectan a los huéspedes de Charlottesville y los condados cercanos con manejo de caso y asistencia de renta hacia una vivienda estable.
eligibility: Day shelter is open to anyone in need age 18 and over; housing programs serve people who are literally homeless or within 14 days of losing housing in the Charlottesville region.
eligibility_es: El refugio de día está abierto a cualquier persona mayor de 18 años; los programas de vivienda sirven a personas literalmente sin hogar o a 14 días de perder su vivienda en la región de Charlottesville.
notes: Drop in any morning or call 434-973-1234 ext. 100; for housing screening call the Homeless Information Line 434-207-2328 and leave a voicemail; for other needs call the Community Resource Line 833-524-2904.
notes_es: Visite cualquier mañana o llame al 434-973-1234 ext. 100; para evaluación de vivienda llame a la Homeless Information Line 434-207-2328 y deje un mensaje; para otras necesidades llame a la Community Resource Line 833-524-2904.
hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (closed 12–1 p.m.); Saturday–Sunday 7:00 a.m.–12:00 noon
services: Day shelter|Showers and laundry|Housing assistance|Homeless prevention|Rapid rehousing

name: House of Hope — Danville Emergency Shelter
description: House of Hope is a faith-based emergency homeless shelter in downtown Danville serving men, women, and children from Danville, Pittsylvania County, and surrounding Southside communities for more than a decade. The shelter provides beds, a morning meal, an evening meal, and bagged lunches to go, plus transitional housing and referrals to local agencies so residents can move toward stable housing and employment.
description_es: House of Hope es un refugio de emergencia basado en la fe en el centro de Danville que sirve a hombres, mujeres y niños de Danville, el condado de Pittsylvania y las comunidades cercanas de Southside desde hace más de una década. El refugio ofrece camas, desayuno, cena y almuerzos para llevar, además de vivienda de transición y referencias a agencias locales para que los residentes avancen hacia vivienda estable y empleo.
eligibility: Anyone needing emergency shelter in the Danville area, including men (Phil and Fran's Place), women, and families with children.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona que necesite refugio de emergencia en el área de Danville, incluidos hombres (Phil and Fran's Place), mujeres y familias con niños.
notes: Check in daily between 5:00 and 7:00 p.m.; call ahead at 434-549-1459 to confirm bed availability; residents are referred to local agencies for daytime meals and services.
notes_es: Regístrese a diario entre las 5:00 y 7:00 p.m.; llame antes al 434-549-1459 para confirmar disponibilidad de camas; se refieren a los residentes a agencias locales para comidas y servicios de día.
hours: Intake daily 5:00–7:00 p.m.; shelter overnight
services: Emergency shelter|Meals|Transitional housing|Agency referrals|Family shelter

name: The Warming Center of Martinsville & Henry County
description: The Warming Center of MHC, a project of the West Piedmont Better Housing Coalition, provides a warm, dry overnight sleep space and a hot meal inside the Salvation Army building in Martinsville on any night temperatures fall to around 38–40 degrees or below, roughly November through March. All guests are welcome and staff connect them to resources for stable housing and other community services in Martinsville and Henry County.
description_es: El Warming Center de MHC, un proyecto de la West Piedmont Better Housing Coalition, ofrece un espacio nocturno cálido y seco para dormir y una comida caliente dentro del edificio del Ejército de Salvación en Martinsville cualquier noche que la temperatura baje a unos 38–40 grados o menos, aproximadamente de noviembre a marzo. Todos son bienvenidos y el personal los conecta con recursos de vivienda estable y otros servicios comunitarios en Martinsville y el condado de Henry.
eligibility: Anyone needing overnight shelter on cold nights in the Martinsville–Henry County area; no residency or sobriety documentation required to enter.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona que necesite refugio nocturno en noches frías en el área de Martinsville–condado de Henry; no se requiere documentación de residencia ni de sobriedad para entrar.
notes: Seasonal: open only on nights near or below 38–40 degrees, roughly November–March; check-in about 7–10 p.m., center closes 8 a.m.; the center is a nighttime operation, so daytime calls may be answered the following evening.
notes_es: Estacional: abre solo en noches cercanas o por debajo de 38–40 grados, aproximadamente de noviembre a marzo; registro de 7 a 10 p.m., cierra a las 8 a.m.; opera de noche, por lo que las llamadas de día pueden responderse la noche siguiente.
hours: Seasonal cold-weather nights, approximately 7:00 p.m.–8:00 a.m.
services: Overnight warming shelter|Hot meal|Housing resource connection|Community service referrals

name: Stone Mountain Health Services (FQHC)
description: Stone Mountain Health Services is a federally qualified health center operating 12 clinics and black lung breathing centers across far Southwest Virginia, serving Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott, Smyth, Tazewell, Washington, and Wise counties and the City of Norton. Clinics provide primary care for all ages, behavioral health counseling, medication assistance, lab services, and black lung services, with fees on a sliding scale for the uninsured.
description_es: Stone Mountain Health Services es un centro de salud federalmente calificado con 12 clínicas y centros respiratorios para pulmón negro en el extremo suroeste de Virginia, sirviendo los condados de Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott, Smyth, Tazewell, Washington y Wise y la ciudad de Norton. Las clínicas ofrecen atención primaria para todas las edades, consejería de salud conductual, asistencia con medicamentos, laboratorio y servicios de pulmón negro, con tarifas de escala móvil para no asegurados.
eligibility: Open to everyone regardless of insurance status or ability to pay; sliding-scale fees based on income; Medicaid, Medicare, and private insurance accepted.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos sin importar el seguro o la capacidad de pago; tarifas de escala móvil según ingresos; se aceptan Medicaid, Medicare y seguros privados.
notes: Jonesville Family Health Center 276-546-3001 (Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–6 p.m.); central administration 276-546-5310 or toll-free 866-297-5250; 12 clinic locations are listed on the website including Damascus and Konnarock.
notes_es: Jonesville Family Health Center 276-546-3001 (lun–vie 8 a.m.–6 p.m.); administración central 276-546-5310 o línea gratuita 866-297-5250; las 12 clínicas aparecen en el sitio web, incluidas Damascus y Konnarock.
hours: Clinic hours vary; Jonesville Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.
services: Primary care|Behavioral health counseling|Black lung services|Medication assistance|Lab services

name: The Health Wagon — Free Clinics of Southwest Virginia
description: The Health Wagon is a nurse practitioner–managed nonprofit providing free medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health care to uninsured and underinsured people at stationary clinics in Wise and Clintwood and mobile units visiting sites across Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott, and Wise counties and the City of Norton. Services include chronic disease management, medication assistance, cancer screenings, specialty clinics, and free health fairs.
description_es: The Health Wagon es una organización sin fines de lucro dirigida por enfermeras practicantes que brinda atención médica, dental, visual y de salud conductual gratuita a personas sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente en clínicas fijas en Wise y Clintwood y unidades móviles que visitan sitios en los condados de Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott y Wise y la ciudad de Norton. Ofrece manejo de enfermedades crónicas, asistencia con medicamentos, detección de cáncer, clínicas de especialidad y ferias de salud gratuitas.
eligibility: Uninsured and underinsured residents of far Southwest Virginia; no fee for care; call to confirm eligibility and clinic schedule.
eligibility_es: Residentes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente del extremo suroeste de Virginia; la atención es gratuita; llame para confirmar elegibilidad y horario de clínicas.
notes: Call 276-328-8850 for appointments and the mobile clinic schedule; specialty clinics include cardiology, endocrinology, women's health, and dental/vision events; hosts the annual RAM-style health outreach in Wise.
notes_es: Llame al 276-328-8850 para citas y el calendario de la clínica móvil; las clínicas de especialidad incluyen cardiología, endocrinología, salud de la mujer y eventos dentales y de visión; organiza la feria de salud anual en Wise.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours; mobile clinic schedule varies
services: Free primary care|Dental and vision care|Chronic disease management|Medication assistance|Specialty clinics

name: Tri-Area Community Health (FQHC)
description: Tri-Area Community Health is a federally qualified health center with clinics in Laurel Fork (Carroll County), Ferrum (Franklin County), Floyd, and Troutdale (Grayson County), plus pharmacies at Laurel Fork and Ferrum. Providers deliver primary care from pediatrics to geriatrics, behavioral health, psychiatric services, clinical pharmacy, diabetes education, x-rays, and family planning, with Medicaid enrollment help and an after-hours on-call line.
description_es: Tri-Area Community Health es un centro de salud federalmente calificado con clínicas en Laurel Fork (condado de Carroll), Ferrum (condado de Franklin), Floyd y Troutdale (condado de Grayson), más farmacias en Laurel Fork y Ferrum. Los proveedores ofrecen atención primaria de pediatría a geriatría, salud conductual, servicios psiquiátricos, farmacia clínica, educación en diabetes, radiografías y planificación familiar, con ayuda de inscripción en Medicaid y línea de guardia fuera de horario.
eligibility: Open to all patients regardless of insurance; sliding-fee discounts available; Medicaid and insurance enrollment assistance offered.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos los pacientes sin importar el seguro; descuentos de escala móvil disponibles; se ofrece ayuda de inscripción en Medicaid y seguros.
notes: Laurel Fork 276-398-2292; Ferrum 540-365-4469; Floyd 540-745-9290; after-hours medical advice via the clinic phone lines; on-site pharmacies at Laurel Fork (276-398-2620) and Ferrum (540-365-6337).
notes_es: Laurel Fork 276-398-2292; Ferrum 540-365-4469; Floyd 540-745-9290; consejo médico fuera de horario por las mismas líneas; farmacias en Laurel Fork (276-398-2620) y Ferrum (540-365-6337).
hours: Monday–Friday, roughly 7:45 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (Laurel Fork Mondays until 6:30 p.m.)
services: Primary care|Behavioral health|Psychiatric services|On-site pharmacy|Diabetes education

name: Bland County Medical Clinic (FQHC)
description: Bland County Medical Clinic is a federally qualified health center founded in 1979 in Bastian, just off I-77 exit 58, with three locations including a dental clinic and the Orchard Creek Clinic. It provides primary and urgent care, behavioral health support, and dental services to Bland County's rural community, with a medical provider on call 24/7 and sliding-scale fees so no one is turned away for inability to pay.
description_es: Bland County Medical Clinic es un centro de salud federalmente calificado fundado en 1979 en Bastian, junto a la salida 58 de la I-77, con tres ubicaciones que incluyen una clínica dental y la Orchard Creek Clinic. Ofrece atención primaria y de urgencia, apoyo de salud conductual y servicios dentales a la comunidad rural del condado de Bland, con un proveedor médico de guardia 24/7 y tarifas de escala móvil para que nadie sea rechazado por no poder pagar.
eligibility: Open to all; sliding-scale fees for uninsured patients; Medicaid, Medicare, and private insurance accepted.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos; tarifas de escala móvil para pacientes sin seguro; se aceptan Medicaid, Medicare y seguros privados.
notes: Main line 276-688-4331 also reaches the 24/7 on-call medical provider; clinic hours Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; dental services available through the partnership with Bland Ministry Center's dental program.
notes_es: La línea principal 276-688-4331 también conecta con el proveedor médico de guardia 24/7; horario lunes–viernes 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; servicios dentales disponibles mediante la alianza con el programa dental del Bland Ministry Center.
hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.; provider on call 24/7
services: Primary care|Urgent care|Dental clinic|Behavioral health support|Sliding-scale fees

name: Southwest Virginia Community Health Systems (FQHC)
description: Southwest Virginia Community Health Systems is a federally qualified health center network with community health centers in Saltville, Meadowview, Tazewell, and Bristol, plus a regional dental center and the New Day Recovery program in Saltville. The centers provide family medicine, pediatrics, behavioral health, optometry, dental care, and addiction recovery support with sliding-scale fees and an after-hours emergency line.
description_es: Southwest Virginia Community Health Systems es una red de centros de salud federalmente calificados con centros comunitarios en Saltville, Meadowview, Tazewell y Bristol, además de un centro dental regional y el programa de recuperación New Day en Saltville. Los centros ofrecen medicina familiar, pediatría, salud conductual, optometría, atención dental y apoyo de recuperación de adicciones con tarifas de escala móvil y una línea de emergencia fuera de horario.
eligibility: Open to all patients; sliding-fee scale for the uninsured; Medicaid, Medicare, and most insurance accepted.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos los pacientes; escala de tarifas móvil para no asegurados; se aceptan Medicaid, Medicare y la mayoría de los seguros.
notes: Saltville 276-496-4433; Meadowview 276-944-3999; Tazewell 276-979-9899; Bristol 276-669-5179; dental center 276-496-4492; after-hours emergencies 1-888-531-8354.
notes_es: Saltville 276-496-4433; Meadowview 276-944-3999; Tazewell 276-979-9899; Bristol 276-669-5179; centro dental 276-496-4492; emergencias fuera de horario 1-888-531-8354.
hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–6:30 p.m. at most locations
services: Family medicine|Behavioral health|Dental care|Optometry|Addiction recovery support

name: Central Virginia Health Services (FQHC network)
description: Central Virginia Health Services is Virginia's oldest community health center network, operating about 19 federally qualified health centers from its New Canton headquarters in Buckingham County. Sites across central and eastern Virginia—including Buckingham, Fluvanna, Cumberland, Charlotte, Caroline, Louisa, Prince Edward, Charles City, Petersburg, Hopewell, Charlottesville, and Fredericksburg—offer medical, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, and addiction treatment with sliding-scale fees.
description_es: Central Virginia Health Services es la red de centros de salud comunitarios más antigua de Virginia, con unas 19 clínicas federalmente calificadas desde su sede en New Canton, condado de Buckingham. Sus sitios en el centro y este de Virginia—incluidos Buckingham, Fluvanna, Cumberland, Charlotte, Caroline, Louisa, Prince Edward, Charles City, Petersburg, Hopewell, Charlottesville y Fredericksburg—ofrecen atención médica, dental, salud conductual, farmacia y tratamiento de adicciones con tarifas de escala móvil.
eligibility: Open to anyone regardless of insurance or ability to pay; sliding-fee discounts based on household income; served 45,000+ patients in 2024.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona sin importar el seguro o la capacidad de pago; descuentos de escala móvil según ingresos del hogar; atendió a más de 45,000 pacientes en 2024.
notes: Buckingham Health Center and administration at New Canton 434-581-3271 (general inquiries 434-581-4073); use the Find a Health Center tool on the website to locate the nearest of the 19 sites.
notes_es: Centro de salud de Buckingham y administración en New Canton 434-581-3271 (consultas generales 434-581-4073); use la herramienta Find a Health Center del sitio web para ubicar el más cercano de los 19 sitios.
hours: Most sites Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. or later
services: Primary care|Dental care|Behavioral health|Pharmacy|Addiction treatment

name: Horizon Behavioral Health (Lynchburg-area CSB)
description: Horizon Behavioral Health is the community services board for the City of Lynchburg and the counties of Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford, and Campbell, providing mental health, substance use, and developmental disability services across the lifespan. Wellness centers in each locality offer assessments, outpatient therapy, psychiatric care, case management, and crisis services, with new clients seen at the Langhorne Wellness Center in Lynchburg.
description_es: Horizon Behavioral Health es la junta de servicios comunitarios de la ciudad de Lynchburg y los condados de Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford y Campbell, ofreciendo servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias y discapacidades del desarrollo en todas las edades. Los centros de bienestar de cada localidad ofrecen evaluaciones, terapia ambulatoria, atención psiquiátrica, manejo de caso y servicios de crisis; los nuevos clientes son atendidos en el Langhorne Wellness Center de Lynchburg.

notes_es: Línea de apoyo entre pares llamada o texto 703-653-4221; entrada del RCC en planta baja frente a Blenheim Boulevard; horario de la van móvil CHR publicado en thecaf.org/chr.
hours: RCC hours vary; peer warm line availability posted on website
services: Peer recovery specialist support|Recovery community center|Free naloxone distribution|Peer Recovery Academy|Comprehensive harm reduction mobile services

name: Bland Ministry Center — Food Pantry & Clothes Closet
description: Bland Ministry Center in Bland provides free emergency food boxes through a volunteer-run food pantry and a clothes closet where families may take up to 50 pounds of donated clothing, accessories, and home goods per member each year. The pantry distributes USDA food boxes on Tuesdays and Thursdays with a rotating schedule by county, and the benevolence program offers limited emergency assistance for utilities, transportation, and other crises after an in-person application.
description_es: Bland Ministry Center en Bland ofrece cajas de alimentos de emergencia gratuitas mediante una despensa administrada por voluntarios y un ropero donde las familias pueden llevarse hasta 50 libras de ropa, accesorios y artículos del hogar donados por miembro al año. La despensa distribuye cajas del USDA los martes y jueves con un calendario rotativo por condado, y el programa de benevolencia ofrece asistencia limitada de emergencia para servicios públicos, transporte y otras crisis tras una solicitud en persona.
eligibility: Anyone in need may register at the food pantry warehouse on distribution days; clothes closet open to all on scheduled days; benevolence requires an in-person application.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona necesitada puede registrarse en la bodega de la despensa en los días de distribución; el ropero está abierto a todos en los días programados; la benevolencia requiere una solicitud en persona.
notes: Food pantry Tue/Thu 10 a.m.–1 p.m. (closed when Bland County Schools are closed); clothes closet Tue 10 a.m.–1 p.m. and Wed 10 a.m.–noon; one food box per household per month.
notes_es: Despensa mar/jue 10 a.m.–1 p.m. (cerrada cuando las escuelas del condado de Bland están cerradas); ropero mar 10 a.m.–1 p.m. y mié 10 a.m.–mediodía; una caja de alimentos por hogar al mes.
hours: Food pantry Tuesday and Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.; clothes closet Tuesday and Wednesday mornings
services: Emergency food boxes|Free clothing|Home goods|Utility and transportation benevolence|Holiday food boxes

name: Ghent Area Ministry — Emergency Assistance
description: Ghent Area Ministry is a faith-based coalition of Ghent-area congregations providing compassionate assistance to marginalized, low-income, and homeless residents of Norfolk. The ministry helps with clothing, limited utility assistance when a disconnection notice is present, prescription medication co-pays (excluding narcotics and psychotropics), city bus passes, and travel assistance, with face-to-face interviews required before aid is approved.
description_es: Ghent Area Ministry es una coalición basada en la fe de congregaciones del área de Ghent que brinda asistencia compasiva a residentes marginados, de bajos ingresos y sin hogar de Norfolk. El ministerio ayuda con ropa, asistencia limitada de servicios públicos cuando hay aviso de corte, copagos de medicamentos recetados (excluyendo narcóticos y psicotrópicos), pases de autobús urbano y ayuda de transporte, con entrevistas presenciales requeridas antes de aprobar la ayuda.
eligibility: Residents of the City of Norfolk only; financial assistance limited to once in a 12-month period; must complete an application and interview with the director or assistant director.
eligibility_es: Solo residentes de la ciudad de Norfolk; asistencia financiera limitada a una vez en un período de 12 meses; debe completar una solicitud y entrevista con el director o subdirector.
notes: Walk-ins and telephone inquiries welcome Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; bring a utility disconnection notice for utility help; Spanish-speaking staff available.
notes_es: Se aceptan visitas y consultas telefónicas lunes–viernes 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; traiga un aviso de corte de servicios para ayuda con servicios públicos; personal que habla español disponible.
hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
services: Clothing assistance|Utility bill help|Prescription co-pay assistance|Bus passes|Travel assistance

name: Mercy Mall of Virginia
description: Mercy Mall of Virginia is a free clothing and housewares boutique in North Chesterfield for individuals and families in crisis, including homelessness, domestic violence, substance use recovery, incarceration, house fires, and extreme poverty. By appointment, clients receive new and gently used clothing, shoes, baby gear, kitchen supplies, linens, toiletries, and cleaning supplies through curbside pickup, with no geographic restrictions and no income documentation required.
description_es: Mercy Mall of Virginia es una boutique gratuita de ropa y artículos del hogar en North Chesterfield para personas y familias en crisis, incluida falta de vivienda, violencia doméstica, recuperación de uso de sustancias, encarcelación, incendios y pobreza extrema. Con cita, los clientes reciben ropa nueva y usada, zapatos, artículos para bebés, utensilios de cocina, ropa de cama, artículos de higiene y limpieza mediante recogida en la acera, sin restricciones geográficas ni documentación de ingresos.
eligibility: Individuals and families experiencing a qualifying crisis; no geographic borders; appointment required via the Get Help tab on the website or by texting 804-728-2928.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias que enfrentan una crisis calificada; sin límites geográficos; cita requerida mediante la pestaña Get Help del sitio web o enviando un mensaje de texto al 804-728-2928.
notes: Curbside pickup appointments Monday–Thursday mid-day; text 804-728-2928 with your name and situation for timely needs; for food call Feed More Hunger Help Line 804-237-8617.
notes_es: Citas de recogida en la acera lunes–jueves al mediodía; envíe un mensaje al 804-728-2928 con su nombre y situación para necesidades urgentes; para alimentos llame a Feed More Hunger Help Line 804-237-8617.
hours: Monday–Thursday, 9:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m. by appointment
services: Free clothing|Baby gear and supplies|Household linens|Toiletries|Cleaning supplies

name: Micah Ecumenical Ministries — Hospitality Services Network
description: Micah Ecumenical Ministries coordinates basic-needs hospitality for people experiencing homelessness in Fredericksburg through a network of downtown partner churches rather than a single walk-in center. Free community meals, shower access, bagged lunch pickup, and clothing resources are available on rotating weekday schedules, with Micah outreach staff present to connect neighbors to housing, the winter shelter, and other regional services.
description_es: Micah Ecumenical Ministries coordina servicios de hospitalidad de necesidades básicas para personas sin hogar en Fredericksburg a través de una red de iglesias aliadas del centro en lugar de un solo centro sin cita. Hay comidas comunitarias gratuitas, acceso a duchas, recogida de almuerzos empacados y recursos de ropa en horarios rotativos entre semana, con personal de alcance de Micah presente para conectar a los vecinos con vivienda, refugio de invierno y otros servicios regionales.
eligibility: Anyone experiencing homelessness or housing instability in the Fredericksburg region; call the Homeless Help Line for current meal, shower, and clothing locations and times.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona sin hogar o con inestabilidad de vivienda en la región de Fredericksburg; llame a la Homeless Help Line para ubicaciones y horarios actuales de comidas, duchas y ropa.
notes: Homeless Help Line 540-358-5801 directs callers to daily meal sites, shower locations (FXBG Baptist Church Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 9–11 a.m.), and bagged lunch pickup schedules; winter shelter coordinated separately.
notes_es: La Homeless Help Line 540-358-5801 dirige a los llamantes a sitios de comidas diarias, ubicaciones de duchas (FXBG Baptist Church lun/mar/jue/vie 9–11 a.m.) y horarios de almuerzos empacados; refugio de invierno coordinado por separado.
hours: Meal and shower schedules vary by partner church; call Help Line for current times
services: Community meals|Shower access|Bagged lunches|Clothing resources|Housing navigation

name: The Least of These Ministry — Showers & Street Outreach
description: The Least of These Ministry serves unsheltered men and women in the Roanoke Valley with showers, laundry access, loving lunches, coffee, and housing search help from its Luck Avenue facility. Open Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings, the ministry provides soap, razors, towels, and refreshments while guests wait for a shower, and assists eligible homeless friends with move-in essentials when they secure affordable housing.
description_es: The Least of These Ministry sirve a hombres y mujeres sin refugio en el valle de Roanoke con duchas, acceso a lavandería, almuerzos solidarios, café y ayuda de búsqueda de vivienda desde su instalación en Luck Avenue. Abierto lunes, miércoles y viernes por la mañana, el ministerio proporciona jabón, rastrillos, toallas y refrigerios mientras los huéspedes esperan su turno, y ayuda a amigos elegibles con artículos de mudanza cuando consiguen vivienda asequible.
eligibility: Unsheltered individuals in the Roanoke Valley; showers and lunches available during open hours or by appointment; housing assistance provided when resources allow.
eligibility_es: Personas sin refugio en el valle de Roanoke; duchas y almuerzos disponibles durante el horario de apertura o con cita; asistencia de vivienda cuando hay recursos.
notes: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 10:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; donation drop-offs welcome same hours; mailing address 602 Marshall Avenue SW; call or email Dawn Sandoval for appointments.
notes_es: Abierto lun/mié/vie 10:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; donaciones bienvenidas en el mismo horario; dirección postal 602 Marshall Avenue SW; llame o escriba a Dawn Sandoval para citas.
hours: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 10:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
services: Showers and hygiene supplies|Laundry access|Community lunches|Housing search assistance|Move-in essentials

name: The Salvation Army Lynchburg — Center of Hope Emergency Services
description: The Salvation Army Center of Hope in Lynchburg provides emergency shelter, a food pantry, a clothes closet, hot meals, and limited rent and utility assistance to struggling individuals and families across Lynchburg and surrounding counties. Applicants need an active eviction notice for rental help or a utility shutoff or past-due notice for energy assistance, and the center serves as a warming and cooling station during extreme temperatures.
description_es: The Salvation Army Center of Hope en Lynchburg ofrece refugio de emergencia, despensa de alimentos, ropero, comidas calientes y asistencia limitada de renta y servicios públicos a personas y familias en dificultades en Lynchburg y los condados cercanos. Los solicitantes necesitan un aviso de desalojo activo para ayuda de renta o un aviso de corte o pago atrasado para asistencia de energía, y el centro funciona como estación de calor y frescor en temperaturas extremas.
eligibility: Residents of Lynchburg, Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford, Campbell, and Nelson counties; utility help requires shutoff notice; rental help requires eviction notice; shelter intake Mon–Fri 9:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Lynchburg y los condados de Amherst, Appomattox, Bedford, Campbell y Nelson; ayuda de servicios requiere aviso de corte; ayuda de renta requiere aviso de desalojo; admisión al refugio lun–vie 9:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.
notes: Call 434-845-5939 for shelter availability weekdays; after 4:30 p.m. and weekends call housing monitors 434-941-4701; Spanish-speaking staff available.
notes_es: Llame al 434-845-5939 para disponibilidad de refugio entre semana; después de las 4:30 p.m. y fines de semana llame a monitores de vivienda 434-941-4701; personal que habla español disponible.
hours: Office Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; shelter intake 9:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.
services: Food pantry|Clothes closet|Hot meals|Rent and utility assistance|Emergency shelter

name: FACETS — Hot Meals & Emergency Food Assistance
description: FACETS operates Northern Virginia's longest-running hot meals program, serving a hot dinner 365 nights a year at two Fairfax County locations through more than 50 faith partners, plus biweekly fresh produce distributions and an emergency pantry with diapers and household items. The hypothermia prevention shelter line operates seasonally, and FACETS connects Fairfax County residents to coordinated services for shelter, employment, and financial help through county referral partners.
description_es: FACETS opera el programa de comidas calientes más antiguo del norte de Virginia, sirviendo cena caliente las 365 noches del año en dos ubicaciones del condado de Fairfax con más de 50 aliados de fe, además de distribuciones quincenales de productos frescos y una despensa de emergencia con pañales y artículos del hogar. La línea del refugio de prevención de hipotermia opera de forma estacional, y FACETS conecta a los residentes del condado de Fairfax con servicios coordinados de refugio, empleo y ayuda financiera.
eligibility: Hot meals open to anyone in need at published locations; emergency food, diapers, and hypothermia shelter referrals for Fairfax County residents; county CSP intake at 703-222-0880 for broader services.
eligibility_es: Comidas calientes abiertas a cualquier persona necesitada en ubicaciones publicadas; alimentos de emergencia, pañales y referencias de refugio de hipotermia para residentes del condado de Fairfax; admisión del condado CSP al 703-222-0880 para servicios más amplios.
notes: Emergency food or diapers call front desk 703-352-5090; hypothermia shelter line ext. 1302 seasonal (Sunday after Thanksgiving through April 1); Fairfax County CSP 703-222-0880 Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
notes_es: Alimentos de emergencia o pañales llame a recepción 703-352-5090; línea de refugio de hipotermia ext. 1302 estacional (domingo después de Acción de Gracias hasta el 1 de abril); CSP del condado de Fairfax 703-222-0880 lun–vie 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
hours: Hot meals nightly; office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Daily hot meals|Fresh produce distribution|Emergency food pantry|Diaper assistance|Hypothermia prevention shelter referral

name: Rescue Mission of Roanoke — Manna Food Pantry
description: The Rescue Mission of Roanoke's Manna Food Pantry distributes weekly grocery boxes of about 60 pounds—including non-perishable staples, fresh produce, frozen meat, and pet food—to struggling families in the Roanoke region through a drive-thru model partnered with Feeding Southwest Virginia. Enrolled recipients also receive free clothing vouchers for the Mission's Donation Center, connecting food insecurity with basic apparel and household needs.
description_es: La despensa Manna Food Pantry de la Rescue Mission of Roanoke distribuye semanalmente cajas de comestibles de unas 60 libras—incluidos productos básicos no perecederos, productos frescos, carne congelada y alimento para mascotas—a familias en dificultades de la región de Roanoke mediante un modelo drive-thru en alianza con Feeding Southwest Virginia. Los inscritos también reciben vales gratuitos de ropa para el Donation Center de la Misión.
eligibility: Open registration for families in the Roanoke region; enroll by text only at 540-598-5203; once enrolled, reserved boxes picked up Wed or Thu 1–3 p.m.
eligibility_es: Inscripción abierta para familias de la región de Roanoke; inscríbase solo por mensaje de texto al 540-598-5203; una vez inscrito, recoja cajas reservadas mié o jue 1–3 p.m.
notes: Text 540-598-5203 to enroll; save reservation texts with QR codes for faster check-in; clothing vouchers redeemable at Donation Center 421 Fourth Street; equal opportunity provider.
notes_es: Envíe un mensaje al 540-598-5203 para inscribirse; guarde los mensajes de reserva con códigos QR para registro más rápido; vales de ropa canjeables en Donation Center 421 Fourth Street; proveedor de igualdad de oportunidades.
hours: Distribution Wednesday and Thursday, 1:00–3:00 p.m. for enrolled clients
services: Weekly grocery boxes|Fresh produce and protein|Pet food|Clothing vouchers|Drive-thru food distribution

name: Assisting Families of Inmates (AFOI)
description: Assisting Families of Inmates is a Richmond-based nonprofit that keeps incarcerated Virginians connected to spouses, children, and parents through video visitation at ten visitor centers statewide, a transportation program for prison visits, DJJ family transportation, and children's services including the MAC program. By reducing isolation and supporting family reunification, AFOI helps returning citizens and their loved ones maintain relationships critical to successful reentry.
description_es: Assisting Families of Inmates es una organización sin fines de lucro con sede en Richmond que mantiene a los virginianos encarcelados conectados con cónyuges, hijos y padres mediante visitas por video en diez centros de visitantes en el estado, un programa de transporte para visitas a prisiones, transporte familiar del DJJ y servicios para niños incluido el programa MAC. Al reducir el aislamiento y apoyar la reunificación familiar, AFOI ayuda a quienes regresan y a sus seres queridos a mantener relaciones críticas para una reinserción exitosa.
eligibility: Families of people incarcerated in Virginia state prisons or DJJ facilities; video visitor centers serve all major VADOC institutions; register through AFOI for visitor center visitation.
eligibility_es: Familias de personas encarceladas en prisiones estatales de Virginia o instalaciones del DJJ; los centros de visitas por video sirven a las principales instituciones de VADOC; regístrese a través de AFOI para visitas en centros de visitantes.
notes: Richmond visitor center open Saturdays and Sundays at 220 Hull Street; register or ask video questions at 804-643-2401 or family@afoi.org; transportation program resumed March 2023.
notes_es: Centro de visitantes de Richmond abierto sábados y domingos en 220 Hull Street; regístrese o pregunte sobre video al 804-643-2401 o family@afoi.org; programa de transporte reanudado en marzo de 2023.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours; Richmond video center Saturday–Sunday
services: Video visitation centers|Prison visit transportation|DJJ family transportation|Children's MAC program|Family reunification support

name: Seton Youth Services — Mentoring Children of Prisoners (MCP)
description: Seton Youth Services operates the free Mentoring Children of Prisoners program for Hampton Roads youth ages 4–18 who have been affected by the past or present incarceration of a parent or adult loved one. Each child is matched with a volunteer mentor age 20 or older for at least four hours per month for one year, providing recreational outings, homework help, and consistent adult friendship—not substitute parenting—for children navigating parental incarceration.
description_es: Seton Youth Services opera el programa gratuito Mentoring Children of Prisoners para jóvenes de Hampton Roads de 4 a 18 años afectados por la encarcelación pasada o presente de un padre o adulto querido. Cada niño es emparejado con un mentor voluntario de 20 años o más durante al menos cuatro horas al mes por un año, con salidas recreativas, ayuda con tareas y amistad adulta constante—no sustituto de crianza—para niños que enfrentan la encarcelación de un padre.
eligibility: Youth ages 4–18 in Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth, Chesapeake, Newport News, or Hampton affected by a parent or loved one's incarceration; mentors must be age 20+ and pass background checks.
eligibility_es: Jóvenes de 4 a 18 años en Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth, Chesapeake, Newport News o Hampton afectados por la encarcelación de un padre o ser querido; los mentores deben tener 20 años o más y pasar verificaciones de antecedentes.
notes: Contact Director of Mentoring Charliesa Day at 757-646-9965 or cday@setonyouthservices.org; mentee and mentor applications online; administrative office 757-963-5795.
notes_es: Contacte a la directora de mentoría Charliesa Day al 757-646-9965 o cday@setonyouthservices.org; solicitudes de mentees y mentores en línea; oficina administrativa 757-963-5795.
hours: Mentoring by appointment; office Monday–Friday business hours
services: One-to-one mentoring|Recreational outings|Homework support|Caregiver communication|Volunteer mentor matching

name: GRTC CARE Paratransit
description: GRTC's CARE (Community Assisted Ride Enterprise) paratransit program provides ADA origin-to-destination curb-to-curb transportation for seniors and people with disabilities who cannot use fixed-route buses in Richmond, Henrico, and portions of Chesterfield. CARE operates within three-quarters of a mile of GRTC bus lines with reservation-based vans and sedans, and CARE Plus extends trips farther into Henrico or Chesterfield for a fee.
description_es: El programa de paratransporte CARE (Community Assisted Ride Enterprise) de GRTC ofrece transporte de origen a destino de acera a acera conforme a la ADA para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades que no pueden usar autobuses de ruta fija en Richmond, Henrico y partes de Chesterfield. CARE opera dentro de tres cuartos de milla de las líneas de autobús de GRTC con vans y sedanes bajo reserva, y CARE Plus extiende viajes más lejos en Henrico o Chesterfield con tarifa.
eligibility: ADA-eligible riders who cannot use fixed-route service; apply through GRTC's Eligibility Coordinator; riders 80+ may apply for a paratransit ID card; visitors with paratransit eligibility may use CARE up to 21 days per year.
eligibility_es: Pasajeros elegibles conforme a la ADA que no pueden usar servicio de ruta fija; solicite a través del coordinador de elegibilidad de GRTC; pasajeros de 80 años o más pueden solicitar una tarjeta de identificación de paratransporte; visitantes con elegibilidad de paratransporte pueden usar CARE hasta 21 días al año.
notes: Schedule rides at 804-782-2273; eligibility questions 804-358-3871 ext. 434; customer service 804-358-4782; completed applications mailed to 301 East Belt Boulevard (not accepted by fax).
notes_es: Programe viajes al 804-782-2273; preguntas de elegibilidad 804-358-3871 ext. 434; servicio al cliente 804-358-4782; solicitudes completas por correo a 301 East Belt Boulevard (no se aceptan por fax).
hours: CARE Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Sat–Sun 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: Curb-to-curb paratransit|ADA eligibility certification|CARE Plus extended trips|Visitor paratransit privileges|Reduced-fare ID cards

name: Mountain Empire Transit (MEOC)
description: Mountain Empire Older Citizens operates Mountain Empire Transit, the public transportation provider for Lee, Scott, and Wise counties and the City of Norton across nearly 1,390 square miles. Free demand-response curb-to-curb trips run Monday through Friday 7 a.m.–5 p.m. with 24-hour advance booking, and the METGo! on-demand microtransit app serves Wise–Norton, Big Stone Gap–Appalachia, and Pennington Gap–Jonesville zones for same-day rides.
description_es: Mountain Empire Older Citizens opera Mountain Empire Transit, el proveedor de transporte público de los condados de Lee, Scott y Wise y la ciudad de Norton en casi 1,390 millas cuadradas. Viajes gratuitos bajo demanda de acera a acera de lunes a viernes de 7 a.m. a 5 p.m. con reserva con 24 horas de anticipación, y la aplicación de microtransporte bajo demanda METGo! sirve las zonas Wise–Norton, Big Stone Gap–Appalachia y Pennington Gap–Jonesville para viajes el mismo día.
eligibility: Open to the public of all ages; wheelchair-accessible vehicles available; demand-response requires booking at least 24 hours ahead; METGo! riders must be 13+ to travel alone.
eligibility_es: Abierto al público de todas las edades; vehículos accesibles para sillas de ruedas; la demanda bajo pedido requiere reserva con al menos 24 horas de anticipación; pasajeros de METGo! deben tener 13 años o más para viajar solos.
notes: Schedule demand-response at 276-523-7433 or toll-free 888-877-6748; METGo! book via app or same phone number; METGo! $1 per trip effective October 2025 per MEOC website.
notes_es: Programe demanda bajo pedido al 276-523-7433 o línea gratuita 888-877-6748; METGo! reserve por aplicación o el mismo número; METGo! $1 por viaje desde octubre de 2025 según el sitio web de MEOC.
hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
services: Demand-response public transit|METGo! on-demand microtransit|Wheelchair-accessible rides|Medical and work trips|Same-day app booking

name: Bay Transit — Demand-Response Public Transit
description: Bay Transit is the public demand-response transportation service operated by Bay Aging, serving 12 counties and several towns across Virginia's Northern Neck and Middle Peninsula including Essex, King and Queen, King William, Lancaster, Richmond, Northumberland, Westmoreland, Gloucester, Mathews, Middlesex, Charles City, and New Kent. Riders call the Ride Line at least 24 hours ahead to schedule curb-to-curb trips Monday through Friday for medical appointments, work, shopping, and other essential travel.
description_es: Bay Transit es el servicio público de transporte bajo demanda operado por Bay Aging, que sirve a 12 condados y varios pueblos del Northern Neck y la península media de Virginia, incluidos Essex, King and Queen, King William, Lancaster, Richmond, Northumberland, Westmoreland, Gloucester, Mathews, Middlesex, Charles City y New Kent. Los pasajeros llaman a la Ride Line con al menos 24 horas de anticipación para programar viajes de acera a acera de lunes a viernes para citas médicas, trabajo, compras y otros desplazamientos esenciales.
eligibility: Open to all ages and all trip purposes in the 12-county service area; New Freedom paratransit for eligible riders with disabilities; base fare $2 with ticket book options.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todas las edades y propósitos de viaje en el área de 12 condados; New Freedom paratransit para pasajeros elegibles con discapacidades; tarifa base $2 con opciones de libreta de boletos.
notes: Ride Line toll-free 877-869-6046, Mon–Fri 6 a.m.–6 p.m.; Warsaw office 804-250-2011; Gloucester office 804-693-6977; call 24 hours in advance to schedule.
notes_es: Ride Line gratuita 877-869-6046, lun–vie 6 a.m.–6 p.m.; oficina de Warsaw 804-250-2011; oficina de Gloucester 804-693-6977; llame con 24 horas de anticipación para programar.
hours: Monday–Friday, 6:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.
services: Demand-response transit|Medical appointment rides|Work and shopping trips|New Freedom paratransit|Seasonal trolley routes

name: VADOC Probation & Parole — District 17 Abingdon
description: VADOC Probation and Parole District 17 supervises justice-involved adults on probation and parole in Bristol, Russell, Smyth, and Washington counties from the Abingdon field office on Hillman Highway. District officers complete risk and needs assessments and refer supervisees to Mount Rogers adult education, Feeding Southwest Virginia partners, and southwest Virginia treatment and employment resources. Probation and parole reporting office—not a walk-in emergency cash or housing intake center.
description_es: La Oficina de Probatoria y Libertad Condicional del Distrito 17 de VADOC en Abingdon supervisa a adultos con antecedentes penales en probatoria y libertad condicional en los condados Bristol, Russell, Smyth y Washington. Los oficiales de distrito realizan evaluaciones de riesgo y necesidades y refieren a educación para adultos Mount Rogers, aliados de Feeding Southwest Virginia y recursos de tratamiento y empleo del suroeste de Virginia. Oficina de reportes, no centro de admisión de vivienda o efectivo de emergencia.
eligibility: Individuals under VADOC community supervision in District 17 localities; report to assigned probation or parole officer.
eligibility_es: Personas bajo supervisión comunitaria de VADOC en localidades del Distrito 17; reporte al oficial de probatoria o libertad condicional asignado.
notes: Serves Bristol, Russell, Smyth, and Washington; pairs with Appalachian Re-Entry Council and Mount Rogers Regional Adult Education.
notes_es: Sirve Bristol, Russell, Smyth y Washington; se vincula con el Consejo de Reinserción Apalache y Educación para Adultos Mount Rogers.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours
services: District probation supervision|Parole reporting|Risk and needs assessment|Treatment referrals|Reentry partner coordination

name: VADOC Probation & Parole — District 18 Norton
description: VADOC Probation and Parole District 18 supervises justice-involved adults in Dickenson, Lee, Scott, Wise counties and Norton from the Park Avenue office in Norton, with additional staff in Clintwood and Duffield. Officers coordinate with the Appalachian Re-Entry Council, RACE1 adult education, and Wise County Career Works for returning citizens rebuilding stability after state custody. District supervision office—not a benefits application or emergency shelter intake site.
