description_es: El Centro de Aprendizaje para Adultos de New River Community College ofrece preparación GED gratuita, alfabetización digital y habilidades de empleabilidad para adultos con antecedentes penales en Floyd, Giles, Montgomery, Pulaski y Radford, incluyendo clases en línea y presenciales. Los graduados conectan con programas de certificado de NRCC y Virginia Career Works New River.
eligibility: Adults age 16+ in New River Valley seeking GED or basic skills; justice-involved adults welcome.
eligibility_es: Adultos de 16 años o más en el Valle New River que buscan GED o habilidades básicas; adultos con antecedentes penales bienvenidos.
notes: Email GED@nr.edu; certified Pearson Vue testing site; distance education options available.
notes_es: Correo GED@nr.edu; sitio certificado Pearson Vue; opciones de educación a distancia disponibles.
hours: Contact for class schedule
services: GED preparation|Digital literacy|Employability skills|Pearson Vue testing|NRCC pathway referrals

name: Patrick & Henry Community College — Middle College GED
description: Patrick and Henry Community College partners with West Piedmont Regional Adult and Career Education and Henry County Public Schools to offer Middle College free daytime GED classes on the Martinsville campus for adults including returning citizens seeking high school equivalency before workforce certificate enrollment. Open-entry programming connects graduates to P&HCC career programs and Martinsville-area employers. Campus-based adult education—not a four-year degree track.
description_es: Patrick and Henry Community College se asocia con West Piedmont Regional Adult and Career Education para ofrecer clases diurnas gratuitas de Middle College GED en el campus de Martinsville para adultos incluidos ciudadanos que regresan que buscan equivalencia de secundaria antes de inscripción en certificados laborales. Programación de entrada abierta conecta graduados con programas de carrera de P&HCC.
eligibility: Adults scoring at 9th grade or above on TABE in Henry County and Martinsville service area.
eligibility_es: Adultos con puntaje de grado 9 o superior en TABE en el área de servicio del condado Henry y Martinsville.
notes: Classes Mon–Thu 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; contact lisa.aquilo@henry.k12.va.us for enrollment and TABE testing.
notes_es: Clases lun–jue 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; contacte lisa.aquilo@henry.k12.va.us para inscripción y examen TABE.
hours: Monday–Thursday 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
services: Campus GED classes|TABE assessment|Workforce certificate pathways|Open-entry enrollment|Employer connections

name: Virginia Department of Education — Adult Education Regional Programs
description: The Virginia Department of Education coordinates 22 regional adult education programs offering free GED and high school equivalency preparation, English literacy, and workforce transition classes in every region of Virginia, helping justice-involved adults locate local providers after release. VDOE publishes regional program contacts by county and city but does not operate classrooms at the Richmond headquarters. Statewide navigation resource—not walk-in GED testing at the state office.
description_es: El Departamento de Educación de Virginia coordina 22 programas regionales de educación para adultos que ofrecen preparación GED gratuita, alfabetización en inglés y clases de transición laboral en cada región, ayudando a adultos con antecedentes penales a localizar proveedores locales después de la liberación. Recurso estatal de navegación, no exámenes GED en la oficina estatal.
eligibility: Virginia adults age 16+ not enrolled in high school; criminal record not a barrier at regional sites.
eligibility_es: Adultos de Virginia de 16 años o más no inscritos en secundaria; los antecedentes penales no son barrera en sitios regionales.
notes: Find your regional provider at doe.virginia.gov adult education page; transcripts via DiplomaSender 855-313-5799.
notes_es: Encuentre su proveedor regional en la página de educación para adultos de doe.virginia.gov; transcripciones vía DiplomaSender 855-313-5799.
hours: Regional sites vary; state office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Regional program locator|GED preparation referrals|English literacy navigation|Workforce transition information

name: Eastern Shore Community College — Adult Education
description: Eastern Shore Community College Adult Education provides GED preparation and adult literacy for low-income adults in Accomack and Northampton counties on Virginia's rural Eastern Shore including returning citizens from regional jails seeking credentials for coastal employment. Free instruction at the Melfa campus connects graduates to ESCC workforce programs and Virginia Career Works Eastern Shore partners. Direct adult education—not a statewide hotline.
description_es: Eastern Shore Community College Educación para Adultos ofrece preparación GED y alfabetización para adultos de bajos ingresos en los condados Accomack y Northampton en la costa rural de Virginia, incluidos ciudadanos que regresan de cárceles regionales. Instrucción gratuita en el campus de Melfa conecta graduados con programas laborales de ESCC.
eligibility: Adults age 16+ on the Eastern Shore seeking GED; justice-involved adults accepted.
eligibility_es: Adultos de 16 años o más en la Eastern Shore que buscan GED; adultos con antecedentes penales aceptados.
notes: Call 757-789-1794 for enrollment; serves both Accomack and Northampton counties.
notes_es: Llame al 757-789-1794 para inscripción; sirve los condados Accomack y Northampton.
hours: Contact for class schedule
services: GED preparation|Adult literacy|ESCC workforce pathways|Regional employment referrals

name: Danville Community College — Workforce Services & Training
description: Danville Community College Workforce Services and Training connects justice-involved adults who earn GED credentials through Danville ACEC to certificate programs, FastForward workforce credentials, and employer partnerships in advanced manufacturing and healthcare across Southside Virginia. Career navigators help returning citizens enroll in short-term training aligned with Virginia Career Works and regional fair-chance employers. College workforce division—not emergency cash or legal aid.
description_es: Danville Community College Workforce Services and Training conecta a adultos con antecedentes penales que obtienen credenciales GED a través de Danville ACEC con programas de certificado, credenciales FastForward y alianzas con empleadores en manufactura avanzada y salud en el Southside de Virginia. Navegadores de carrera ayudan a quienes regresan a inscribirse en capacitación de corto plazo.
eligibility: Southside Virginia adults including GED completers and justice-involved trainees meeting program requirements.
eligibility_es: Adultos del Southside de Virginia incluidos quienes completan GED y participantes con antecedentes penales que cumplan requisitos del programa.
notes: Pairs with Danville ACEC and VLAS; FastForward workforce credentials listed at danville.edu/WFSFinAid; workforce director 434-797-8573.
notes_es: Se vincula con Danville ACEC y VLAS; credenciales FastForward en danville.edu/WFSFinAid; director de fuerza laboral 434-797-8573.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours
services: Workforce certificate programs|FastForward credentials|Career navigation|Employer partnerships|GED-to-career pathways

name: Southwest Virginia Community College — Adult Education Pathways
description: Southwest Virginia Community College connects adults in Buchanan, Dickenson, Russell, and Tazewell counties to GED preparation through its Southwest Regional Adult Education partner and to FastForward workforce certificate programs on campus in Richlands. College admissions and workforce staff help credential earners move from adult education into certificate programs and local employment through partnerships with the Southwest Virginia Workforce Development Board. College pathway services—not a probation office.
description_es: Southwest Virginia Community College conecta a adultos en los condados Buchanan, Dickenson, Russell y Tazewell con preparación GED a través de su socio Southwest Regional Adult Education y con programas de certificados FastForward en el campus de Richlands. El personal de admisiones y fuerza laboral ayuda a quienes obtienen credenciales a pasar de educación para adultos a programas de certificado y empleo local.
eligibility: Adults age 18+ in Buchanan, Dickenson, Russell, and Tazewell seeking GED pathways or SWCC workforce certificates.
eligibility_es: Adultos de 18 años o más en Buchanan, Dickenson, Russell y Tazewell que buscan vías GED o certificados laborales de SWCC.
notes: GED prep through Southwest Regional Adult Education at 276-889-5424 (adulted.russell.k12.va.us); SWCC workforce partners at sw.edu/workforce/partners.html.
notes_es: Preparación GED con Southwest Regional Adult Education al 276-889-5424 (adulted.russell.k12.va.us); socios laborales en sw.edu/workforce/partners.html.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours
services: GED pathway referrals|Workforce certificate programs|College admissions support|FastForward credentials|Regional workforce board partnerships

name: Salem VA Medical Center — Veterans Justice Outreach
description: Salem VA Medical Center Veterans Justice Outreach specialists connect justice-involved veterans in the Roanoke Valley, New River Valley, and southwest Virginia to VA mental health, substance use treatment, and housing services after contact with local courts and jails. VJO staff provide direct outreach, assessment, and case management—not legal representation. VA enrollment and eligibility determination required for medical services.
description_es: Los especialistas de Veterans Justice Outreach del Salem VA Medical Center conectan a veteranos con antecedentes penales en el valle de Roanoke, el valle New River y el suroeste de Virginia con salud mental del VA, tratamiento de uso de sustancias y vivienda después del contacto con tribunales y cárceles locales. El personal VJO ofrece alcance directo y manejo de casos, no representación legal.
eligibility: Justice-involved veterans with qualifying military service in western Virginia; VA eligibility required.
eligibility_es: Veteranos con antecedentes penales con servicio militar calificado en el oeste de Virginia; se requiere elegibilidad del VA.
notes: VJO contact Machele Huff ext. 2499; main line 540-982-2463; coordinates with DVS Salem office.
notes_es: Contacto VJO Machele Huff ext. 2499; línea principal 540-982-2463; coordina con oficina DVS de Salem.
hours: VA business hours; call for VJO appointment
services: Veterans Justice Outreach|VA mental health referrals|Substance use treatment|Housing navigation|Court and jail liaison

name: Hunter Holmes McGuire VA — Veterans Justice Outreach
description: Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center Veterans Justice Outreach serves justice-involved veterans in Richmond and central Virginia jails and courts, linking eligible veterans to VA behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, and homeless prevention services to reduce unnecessary incarceration. VJO specialists collaborate with local justice partners and veteran treatment courts—not a crisis hotline. VA eligibility required for clinical care.
description_es: Veterans Justice Outreach del Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center sirve a veteranos con antecedentes penales en cárceles y tribunales de Richmond y el centro de Virginia, vinculándolos con salud conductual del VA, tratamiento de trastornos por uso de sustancias y prevención de falta de vivienda. Los especialistas VJO colaboran con tribunales de tratamiento para veteranos, no es línea de crisis.
eligibility: Justice-involved veterans in central Virginia with qualifying military service; VA enrollment required.
eligibility_es: Veteranos con antecedentes penales en el centro de Virginia con servicio militar calificado; se requiere inscripción en el VA.
notes: VJO Chris Woods ext. 2116; HCRV Jim Temple ext. 4191 for state prison releases.
notes_es: VJO Chris Woods ext. 2116; HCRV Jim Temple ext. 4191 para liberaciones de prisión estatal.
hours: VA business hours
services: Veterans Justice Outreach|VA behavioral health|Substance use treatment|Treatment court coordination|Homeless prevention

name: Hampton VA Medical Center — Veterans Justice Outreach
description: Hampton VA Medical Center Veterans Justice Outreach connects justice-involved veterans in Hampton Roads jails and courts to VA mental health, substance use treatment, and community supports, working to avoid unnecessary criminalization of veterans in crisis. VJO specialist Tamesha Ellis coordinates with local law enforcement and Norfolk-area veteran treatment resources. VA medical enrollment required—not emergency legal aid.
description_es: Veterans Justice Outreach del Hampton VA Medical Center conecta a veteranos con antecedentes penales en cárceles y tribunales de Hampton Roads con salud mental del VA, tratamiento de uso de sustancias y apoyos comunitarios. La especialista VJO Tamesha Ellis coordina con fuerzas del orden locales y recursos de tratamiento para veteranos del área de Norfolk.
eligibility: Justice-involved veterans in Hampton Roads with qualifying military service; VA eligibility determination required.
eligibility_es: Veteranos con antecedentes penales en Hampton Roads con servicio militar calificado; se requiere determinación de elegibilidad del VA.
notes: VJO ext. 7741; pairs with VVFS Justice Involved Services and Norfolk P&P District 2 reentry council.
notes_es: VJO ext. 7741; se vincula con VVFS Justice Involved Services y consejo de reinserción del Distrito 2 de Norfolk.
hours: VA business hours
services: Veterans Justice Outreach|VA mental health|Substance use referrals|Jail and court outreach|Treatment coordination

name: McGuire VA — Health Care for Reentry Veterans (HCRV)
description: The Health Care for Reentry Veterans program at Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center provides pre-release outreach and post-release case management for veterans in Virginia state prisons within six months of release, connecting them to VA health care, benefits, and housing resources. HCRV specialist Jim Temple coordinates prison visits and community linkages—not criminal defense or emergency cash. For local jail veterans, contact VJO instead.
description_es: El programa Health Care for Reentry Veterans en Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center ofrece alcance previo a la liberación y manejo de casos posterior para veteranos en prisiones estatales de Virginia dentro de los seis meses previos a la liberación. El especialista HCRV Jim Temple coordina visitas a prisiones y vínculos comunitarios, no defensa penal ni efectivo de emergencia.
eligibility: Veterans in Virginia state custody within six months of release with qualifying military service.
eligibility_es: Veteranos en custodia estatal de Virginia dentro de los seis meses previos a la liberación con servicio militar calificado.
notes: HCRV Jim Temple ext. 4191; ask facility counselor to schedule HCRV visit before release.
notes_es: HCRV Jim Temple ext. 4191; pida al consejero de la instalación programar visita HCRV antes de la liberación.
hours: VA business hours; prison visits by appointment
services: Pre-release VA outreach|Post-release case management|VA benefits enrollment|Housing referrals|Health care linkage

name: Salem VA — Health Care for Reentry Veterans (HCRV)
description: Salem VA Medical Center Health Care for Reentry Veterans specialists visit Virginia DOC facilities in western Virginia to meet veterans before release and coordinate VA health care, mental health, substance use treatment, and housing supports in coalfield and southwest Virginia communities. HCRV prevents homelessness and supports veteran reintegration—not a veterans crisis line. Local jail veterans should contact VJO.
description_es: Los especialistas Health Care for Reentry Veterans del Salem VA Medical Center visitan instalaciones del DOC de Virginia en el oeste para reunirse con veteranos antes de la liberación y coordinar atención médica del VA, salud mental, tratamiento de uso de sustancias y vivienda en comunidades del suroeste. HCRV previene la falta de vivienda; veteranos en cárceles locales deben contactar VJO.
eligibility: Veterans in Virginia state prisons in western Virginia within six months of release.
eligibility_es: Veteranos en prisiones estatales de Virginia en el oeste dentro de los seis meses previos a la liberación.
notes: HCRV Leslie Hindle; coordinate through facility reentry staff or VADOC veterans roadmap.
notes_es: HCRV Leslie Hindle; coordine a través del personal de reinserción de la instalación o la guía de veteranos de VADOC.
hours: VA business hours
services: Prison pre-release outreach|VA enrollment assistance|Substance use treatment referrals|Housing navigation|Post-release case management

name: Virginia DVS — Abingdon Veterans Services Office
description: The Virginia Department of Veterans Services Abingdon office helps veterans and families obtain federal and state benefits including disability compensation, health care enrollment, and discharge upgrades, serving justice-involved veterans in Bristol, Russell, Smyth, and Washington counties. Veterans Service Representatives also coordinate with VVFS Justice Involved Services co-located at this site. Benefits advocacy—not emergency mental health crisis response.
description_es: La oficina de Abingdon del Departamento de Servicios para Veteranos de Virginia ayuda a veteranos y familias a obtener beneficios federales y estatales incluyendo compensación por discapacidad e inscripción en atención médica, sirviendo a veteranos con antecedentes penales en Bristol, Russell, Smyth y Washington. Los representantes también coordinan con VVFS Justice Involved Services en este sitio.
eligibility: Veterans and eligible family members; justice-involved veterans welcome for benefits navigation.
eligibility_es: Veteranos y familiares elegibles; veteranos con antecedentes penales bienvenidos para navegación de beneficios.
notes: Appointments recommended Mon–Fri 9:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; monthly outreach in Marion; closed last business day of month.
notes_es: Citas recomendadas lun–vie 9:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; alcance mensual en Marion; cerrado el último día hábil del mes.
hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: VA benefits claims assistance|Disability compensation|Health care enrollment|Discharge upgrade help|VVFS JIS coordination

name: Virginia DVS — Big Stone Gap Veterans Services Office
description: The Virginia Department of Veterans Services Big Stone Gap office assists veterans in Dickenson, Lee, Scott, and Wise counties and Norton with federal VA benefits, state veterans benefits, and referrals to VVFS behavioral health supports for justice-involved veterans returning to coalfield communities. Mobile outreach visits Clintwood, Grundy, and Haysi monthly. Veterans benefits office—not a probation reporting site.
description_es: La oficina de Big Stone Gap del Departamento de Servicios para Veteranos de Virginia asiste a veteranos en Dickenson, Lee, Scott y Wise y Norton con beneficios federales del VA, beneficios estatales y referencias a apoyos conductuales de VVFS para veteranos con antecedentes penales que regresan a comunidades carboníferas. Visitas móviles mensuales a Clintwood, Grundy y Haysi.
eligibility: Veterans in Dickenson, Lee, Scott, Wise counties and Norton; appointments recommended.
eligibility_es: Veteranos en los condados Dickenson, Lee, Scott, Wise y Norton; citas recomendadas.
notes: Mobile outreach in Clintwood, Grundy, Haysi; request appointment online at dvs.virginia.gov.
notes_es: Alcance móvil en Clintwood, Grundy, Haysi; solicite cita en línea en dvs.virginia.gov.
hours: Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: VA benefits assistance|State veterans benefits|Mobile county outreach|VVFS referrals|Justice-involved veteran support

name: Virginia DVS — Tazewell Veterans Services Office
description: The Virginia Department of Veterans Services Tazewell office serves veterans in Buchanan and Tazewell counties with benefits claims assistance, health care enrollment navigation, and connections to VVFS Justice Involved Services for veterans on supervision or recently released from regional jails and state prisons in southwest Virginia. Veterans Service Representatives by appointment— not emergency shelter intake.
description_es: La oficina de Tazewell del Departamento de Servicios para Veteranos de Virginia sirve a veteranos en los condados Buchanan y Tazewell con asistencia de reclamos de beneficios, navegación de inscripción en atención médica y conexiones con VVFS Justice Involved Services para veteranos bajo supervisión o recién liberados.
eligibility: Veterans in Buchanan and Tazewell counties; justice-involved veterans welcome.
eligibility_es: Veteranos en los condados Buchanan y Tazewell; veteranos con antecedentes penales bienvenidos.
notes: Appointments recommended; closed last business day of month; pairs with VADOC District 43.
notes_es: Citas recomendadas; cerrado el último día hábil del mes; se vincula con el Distrito 43 de VADOC.
hours: Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: VA disability claims|Health care enrollment|Benefits counseling|VVFS JIS referrals|Rural veterans outreach

name: Virginia DVS — Salem/Roanoke Veterans Services Office
description: The Virginia Department of Veterans Services office at Salem VA Medical Center helps veterans in Roanoke, Salem, Radford, Pulaski, Henry, Patrick, and surrounding localities file VA disability claims, access health care, and connect to VVFS supports for justice-involved veterans rebuilding stability after jail or prison. Co-located with VA campus services—not a DMV or legal aid office. Appointments strongly recommended.
description_es: La oficina del Departamento de Servicios para Veteranos en el Salem VA Medical Center ayuda a veteranos en Roanoke, Salem, Radford, Pulaski, Henry, Patrick y localidades circundantes a presentar reclamos de discapacidad del VA, acceder a atención médica y conectarse con apoyos de VVFS para veteranos con antecedentes penales. Citas muy recomendadas.
eligibility: Veterans in Roanoke Valley and southwest Piedmont service area; walk-ins time permitting.
eligibility_es: Veteranos en el área de servicio del valle de Roanoke y suroeste del Piedmont; sin cita según disponibilidad.
notes: Call ext. 6547 for appointment; outreach in Rocky Mount and Clifton Forge; VJO co-located at Salem VA.
notes_es: Llame ext. 6547 para cita; alcance en Rocky Mount y Clifton Forge; VJO en el mismo campus del Salem VA.
hours: Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: VA claims assistance|Health care enrollment|State veterans benefits|VVFS coordination|Rural outreach scheduling

name: VDH Division of Vital Records
description: The Virginia Department of Health Division of Vital Records issues certified Virginia birth, death, marriage, and divorce certificates needed for DMV IDs, SNAP, Medicaid, and employment after release. Returning citizens born in Virginia may apply by mail to the Richmond office or in person at any DMV customer service center using forms DL-81 or DL-82. Vital records office—not a probation reporting location.
description_es: La División de Registros Vitales del Departamento de Salud de Virginia emite certificados oficiales de nacimiento, defunción, matrimonio y divorcio necesarios para identificaciones del DMV, SNAP, Medicaid y empleo después de la liberación. Los ciudadanos que regresan nacidos en Virginia pueden solicitar por correo a la oficina de Richmond o en persona en cualquier centro del DMV.
eligibility: Virginia-born individuals and eligible immediate family requesting certified vital records with acceptable ID.
eligibility_es: Personas nacidas en Virginia y familiares inmediatos elegibles que soliciten registros vitales certificados con identificación aceptable.
notes: Mail applications to P.O. Box 1000, Richmond, VA 23218; $12 mail fee; DMV in-person option prints many records immediately.
notes_es: Envíe solicitudes a Apartado 1000, Richmond, VA 23218; tarifa por correo $12; opción en persona en DMV imprime muchos registros de inmediato.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours
services: Birth certificate issuance|Marriage and divorce records|Death certificate copies|Mail-in applications|DMV partnership referrals

name: Virginia DMV Connect — Community Mobile Offices
description: Virginia DMV Connect mobile teams bring driver's licenses, state ID cards, vital records ordering, and knowledge testing to libraries, colleges, employers, and community sites across Virginia when returning citizens cannot reach a fixed DMV office. Fourteen regional mobile units serve rural and justice-involved communities after release, with certificates mailed for vital records transactions. Mobile DMV—not emergency cash assistance.
description_es: Los equipos móviles Virginia DMV Connect llevan licencias de conducir, tarjetas de identificación estatal, pedidos de registros vitales y exámenes de conocimientos a bibliotecas, colegios y sitios comunitarios en toda Virginia cuando quienes regresan no pueden llegar a una oficina fija del DMV. Catorce unidades móviles regionales sirven comunidades rurales después de la liberación.
eligibility: Virginia residents needing DMV services at scheduled community visits; walk-ins at some locations per calendar.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Virginia que necesitan servicios del DMV en visitas comunitarias programadas; sin cita en algunos sitios según calendario.
notes: View full calendar at dmv.virginia.gov mobile offices; book appointment when required; vital records mailed from VDH.
notes_es: Vea el calendario completo en oficinas móviles de dmv.virginia.gov; reserve cita cuando se requiera; registros vitales enviados por VDH.
hours: Visit schedules vary by location; check online calendar
services: State ID cards|Driver's licenses|Vital records ordering|Knowledge testing|Address changes

name: Project ID — Virginia ID Assistance
description: Project ID Action Fund supports Virginia chapters that help justice-involved and low-income residents obtain birth certificates, state IDs, and voting documents by covering fees and navigating multi-step vital records processes. Chapters operate in Richmond, New River Valley, Hampton Roads, and other regions—volunteer-led ID navigation, not clinical treatment or legal representation. Request help through the statewide online form.
description_es: Project ID Action Fund apoya capítulos de Virginia que ayudan a residentes con antecedentes penales y de bajos ingresos a obtener certificados de nacimiento, identificaciones estatales y documentos de votación cubriendo tarifas y navegando procesos de registros vitales. Capítulos en Richmond, el valle New River y Hampton Roads; navegación de identificación liderada por voluntarios.
eligibility: Virginia residents needing help obtaining government ID who cannot afford fees or navigate records processes alone.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Virginia que necesitan ayuda para obtener identificación gubernamental y no pueden pagar tarifas o navegar procesos solos.
notes: Apply at projectidaf.org/virginia; volunteer email idsforlife@projectid.org; chapters include New River Valley and Hampton Roads.
notes_es: Solicite en projectidaf.org/virginia; correo de voluntarios idsforlife@projectid.org; capítulos incluyen New River Valley y Hampton Roads.
hours: Contact chapter for availability
services: ID fee assistance|Birth certificate navigation|DMV appointment help|Volunteer document coaching|Regional chapter referrals

name: CommonHelp Virginia — Benefits Portal
description: CommonHelp is the Virginia Department of Social Services secure online portal where returning citizens and families check eligibility and apply for SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, energy assistance, and child care help after release. Users create an account to submit applications, upload documents, report household changes, and track case status in English and Spanish. Online benefits portal—not a walk-in crisis shelter or legal aid office.
description_es: CommonHelp es el portal en línea seguro del Departamento de Servicios Sociales de Virginia donde quienes regresan y las familias verifican elegibilidad y solicitan SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, asistencia energética y ayuda de cuidado infantil después de la liberación. Los usuarios crean una cuenta para enviar solicitudes y rastrear el estado del caso en inglés y español.
eligibility: Virginia residents seeking public benefits; separate Medicaid line 855-242-8282 for health coverage only.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Virginia que buscan beneficios públicos; línea separada de Medicaid 855-242-8282 solo para cobertura de salud.
notes: Enterprise Call Center 833-5CALLVA; CoverVA 855-242-8282; pair with local VDSS office for document help.
notes_es: Centro de llamadas 833-5CALLVA; CoverVA 855-242-8282; combínelo con la oficina local de VDSS para ayuda con documentos.
hours: Online 24/7; phone support Monday–Friday business hours
services: SNAP applications|Medicaid enrollment|TANF screening|Energy assistance|Child care assistance

name: Virginia DBHDS — Community Services Board Directory
description: The Virginia Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services maintains the statewide Community Services Board and Behavioral Health Authority directory connecting justice-involved Virginians to local mental health, substance use, and crisis services including 988 and CSB emergency teams in every locality. Returning citizens use the directory to find their county CSB for Medicaid behavioral health intake—not a housing or employment office. Navigation resource with local direct services through CSBs.
description_es: El Departamento de Salud Conductual y de Servicios de Desarrollo de Virginia mantiene el directorio estatal de Juntas de Servicios Comunitarios que conecta a virginianos con antecedentes penales con servicios locales de salud mental, uso de sustancias y crisis incluyendo 988 en cada localidad. Recurso de navegación con servicios directos locales a través de CSB.
eligibility: Virginia residents seeking public behavioral health or developmental services through their local CSB.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Virginia que buscan servicios públicos de salud conductual o del desarrollo a través de su CSB local.
notes: Call 988 for crisis; find local CSB at dbhds.virginia.gov/find-help or vacsb.org directory.
notes_es: Llame al 988 para crisis; encuentre su CSB en dbhds.virginia.gov/find-help o el directorio vacsb.org.
hours: 988 available 24/7; CSB hours vary by locality
services: CSB locator|Crisis services navigation|Substance use treatment referrals|Mental health intake|988 crisis routing

name: Goodwill Industries of the Valleys — GoodStart Reentry Program
description: Goodwill Industries of the Valleys GoodStart Reentry Program provides case management, soft-skills training, occupational skills pathways including welding and CDL preparation, and job placement for justice-involved adults ages 18 and older convicted in Virginia across 35 counties and 14 cities in central and southwest Virginia. The three-phase program reports low recidivism and connects participants to fair-chance employers—not emergency housing.
description_es: El programa GoodStart Reentry de Goodwill Industries of the Valleys ofrece manejo de casos, capacitación en habilidades blandas, vías de habilidades ocupacionales incluyendo soldadura y preparación CDL, y colocación laboral para adultos con antecedentes penales de 18 años o más en 35 condados y 14 ciudades del centro y suroeste de Virginia.
eligibility: Virginia adults age 18+ with adult convictions seeking reentry employment services in Goodwill Valleys territory.
eligibility_es: Adultos de Virginia de 18 años o más con condenas como adultos que buscan servicios de empleo de reinserción en el territorio de Goodwill Valleys.

description: Valley Mission in Staunton operates one of the few shelters within 100 miles that serves single men, single women, and families with 24/7 emergency beds, meals, case management, GED classes, housing-fund assistance, and pastoral counseling. Justice-involved adults returning to Augusta County, Staunton, or Waynesboro can call for bed availability and complete intake with photo ID. Direct shelter and reentry support—not a statewide benefits hotline or legal clinic.
